slides.title: COLOR FILTER
settings: More vibrant, players stand out from the map
Filter on the world and the HUD
Lower it if the colors look too strong

slides.title: ENEMIES + CROSSHAIR
slides.foot: TEST NEW COLORS ON A BRIGHT AND A DARK MAP
settings: Easier to tell your squad from enemies
Other colors mix with the red kill hitmarker
Only test it if players still blend in

slides.title: SHARPNESS + BRIGHTNESS
slides.foot: SOURCES: GAMESPOT · GAME8 · EXPEL · SKYCOACH · GAMERBLURB
settings: PS5 Settings › Screen and Video › Video Output

source: GameSpot best MW4 settings 16.10. (FidelityFX CAS on, 50-80; blur off), Game8 best settings 18.10. (CAS on 50-80, film grain off), ConquestCapped 26.10.
